content_units: Birthday Game Night Fit

For 7 adults, the best picks are fast-to-teach party and light-strategy games that scale cleanly to 7, avoid early knockouts, and keep a whole evening moving. The strongest matches for your group are   Decrypto  ,   Wavelength  ,   Just One  , and   7 Wonders   because they hit bluffing/team play/light strategy while staying easy to learn and usually under   €45  .
Best 8 Games for Your Group
Game   Players   Time   Teach Time   Typical Price   Why it fits
Decrypto   3-8   30 min   8 min   €20-€25   Team wordplay with deduction, bluffing, and zero elimination
Wavelength   2-12   30-45 min   5 min   €30-€35   Excellent party team game with discussion and fast turns
Just One   3-7   20-30 min   3 min   €20-€25   Co-op word guessing, effortless to teach, great warm-up
7 Wonders   3-7   30-40 min   10 min   €35-€45   Best light strategy option for exactly 7 players
Codenames   4-8+   15-30 min   5 min   €15-€20   Team deduction with quick rounds and broad appeal
Sushi Go Party!   2-8   20-30 min   5 min   €20-€30   Light drafting strategy, cheerful, very replayable
Dixit Odyssey   3-12   30 min   5 min   €30-€35   Creative bluff-adjacent clueing, scales very well to 7
Camel Up (Second Edition)   3-8   30-45 min   8 min   €35-€40   Funny betting game with light strategy and group energy
Ranked Picks
Option 1:   Decrypto     Best overall match for bluffing + team play + easy teaching     Ideal core game
- Works brilliantly at 7.
- Team-based, interactive, and clever without being rules-heavy.
- No one gets removed; everyone stays involved the whole time.
Option 2:   Wavelength     Best social opener or mid-evening team game     Fastest crowd-pleaser
- Very easy to explain.
- Strong table talk and laughter.
- Great if some guests are not hobby gamers.
Option 3:   7 Wonders     Best light-strategy pick for 7 players     Most strategic
- Simultaneous play keeps downtime low.
- Strong replay value.
- Fits your “light strategy” preference better than most 7-player games.
Option 4:   Just One     Best warm-up game before heavier picks     Most accessible
- Cooperative and welcoming.
- Almost no rules friction.
- Excellent for mixed gaming experience levels.
Smooth 2-3 Hour Game Plan
A strong flow for your birthday night:
-   Start:   Just One — 20 to 30 min
-   Main event:   Decrypto — 30 to 45 min
-   Strategy slot:   7 Wonders — 35 to 45 min
-   Finish:   Wavelength or Camel Up — 30 to 45 min
That gives you about   2 hr 5 min to 2 hr 45 min   with natural snack/chat breaks.
Buying Notes for Europe
A few practical notes:
- All 8 games are commonly found at or below   €45   in Europe.
-   7 Wonders   is usually the one closest to your budget cap.
- If you want the cheapest set of top picks, prioritize   Codenames  ,   Just One  ,   Decrypto  , and   Sushi Go Party!  .
